title: Guard & Grow
subtitle: Development of a mini-game with navigation systems and AI behavior in NPCs.
description:
Guard and Grow is a simple top-down clicker-style mini-game in which the player must protect his orchard from crows and flies trying to steal the potatoes. While the farmer harvests them, the player controls a scarecrow that, by clicking on different areas, scares the creatures away using a rechargeable energy system.

The game incorporates navigation systems and AI behavior in NPCs, developed as programming practice for the university's Artificial Intelligence course.

I also created the visual art for the project to give it personality and authenticity.
